description: Coverage map of routes, UI states, verticals (themes), feature flags and viewports. Wave 9 adds two non-weather verticals (Health, Beauty) on the new 'appointments' profile, with their own care hubs and SEO-landing content. Wave 10 replaces the fixture phone/OTP login with the Core OIDC redirect presentation: route auth.oidc at /login, module core-oidc-auth. Wave 11 ships the Beauty seo.landing as the Calm Harbor Spa release: seo-products-teaser (public PIM retail teaser), CMS media slots on hero/proof, and honest-navigation public CTAs (nav.services / nav.pricing / nav.products / auth.gotoSignin — no booking/payment/checkout command).

profiles.note: Portal profile is config-driven per vertical (fixtures.profileFor). Drives nav, primary action, cart, and which Calendar renders.

appointments.note: No weather triggers: these verticals set fixtures.themes[x].wt = null, which removes the Weather Trigger banner/panel and the weather feed item everywhere.

routes.note: Hero + quote card + service teasers; adapts per profile (onDemand vs stormOps copy).

Public SEO landing — ONE reusable section set (src/components/seo/SeoSections.js) serves all eight verticals; content = CMS slots in data/seo-fixtures.js keyed by vertical. Sections: seo-hero, seo-trust-strip, seo-services-grid, seo-how-it-works, seo-proof, seo-pricing, seo-service-area, seo-reviews, seo-faq (schema.org FAQPage microdata), seo-final-cta, seo-footer. loading/empty apply ONLY to dynamic-data sections (trust, pricing, service-area, reviews, faq, hero offer); hero/how/proof/footer are static. CTA lifecycle idle|pending|success|error on data-state of every seo-cta — preview via dev-toolbar 'cta' select. Head-level CMS fields (seoTitle, metaDescription, canonical, locality, primaryCta.destination) surfaced by the dev-only seo-meta-preview block (data-dev-toolbar — stripped on integration). Wave 11 (Calm Harbor / Beauty): seo-products-teaser sits between seo-pricing and seo-service-area — 3–4 cards from the repeated public PIM collection (pim.products[], data-product-code), public fields only, ONE action nav.products; states ready|loading|empty (seo-products-teaser-empty = honest empty catalog, no invented products). Hero + proof accept CMS media slots (cms.media.hero/proof — spec in MEDIA-SPEC.md). Beauty public CTAs are honest navigation ONLY: nav.services / nav.pricing (scroll to live sections), nav.products (public Shop route), auth.gotoSignin — no seo.cta.book/quote, payment, checkout, booking command or 'request sent' state; service cards route to pricing in this mode. book/quote verticals unchanged. Cover ready+empty at 1440/1180/768/390 in light and dark beauty modes. Wave 12: Beauty seo-pricing ready state renders the repeated LIVE public PIM collection pim.pricing[] (seo-pricing-row: code/name/displayPrice/optional interval|shortDescription, data-product-code; SPA_SERVICE + SPA_MEMBERSHIP only, never SPA_RETAIL; displayPrice verbatim — never computed); empty = honest no-published-items copy, no quote/booking/fallback price; public preview nav brand = cms.meta.brand (Calm Harbor Spa). Pricing evidence: previews/calm-harbor/pricing-{state}-{width}-{mode}.png — real viewport pixels, ready/loading/empty × desktop 1440 (1440×900, upscaled from a scaled-to-fit capture) + mobile 390 (true 390×540) × light/dark.

Core OIDC login (module core-oidc-auth) — authorization-code+PKCE redirect to the Core account service, returning to the same /login URL. checking-session = bootstrap on every load (incl. the callback return): discovery + session restore — non-interactive, no redirect claim, no controls, no session name. One primary action per interactive state: auth.oidcSignIn / auth.retrySession (unavailable = discovery/library init failure, no fallback login) / auth.signOut. Dynamic data = session status + one customer-safe display name (data-bind session.displayName). No password/token/Account-id in the browser. Public catalog nav stays before and after auth. Preview the states via the dev-toolbar 'oidc' select.
fixture phone step — kept for visual reference, reachable only via dev toolbar (auth.gotoSignin now routes to auth.oidc)
fixture 4-digit OTP step — kept for visual reference, reachable only via dev toolbar

variants.stormOps: weather-ops agenda: served, clear, storm-watch, snow-expected + event statuses scheduled/on-route/completed/skipped/delayed

routes.note: Vertical care hub — content is vertical-specific (fixtures.careModules): HVAC equipment passport + diagnostics; Snow season/compliance log; Lawn season program + re-entry; Pool water quality; Roofing inspection report + project tracker; Pest station monitoring. Nav label comes from careModules[theme].navLabel. 'unauthorized' renders the entitlement-gate (plan doesn't include the hub). Wave 9: Health hub (kind healthCare) = upcoming appointment + care-plan milestones + follow-up tasks + secure documents (metadata only — NO clinical metrics/results rendered, by design) + provider card; Beauty hub (kind beautyCare) = appointment + session package + specialist preference + treatment/routine history + loyalty + routine products. Data contracts: care.selectUnit -> unit.id; care.download -> document.id; care.requestRetreat -> plan.planId + data-property-id + data-service-id; care.selectSpecialist -> specialist.id; care.completeTask -> task.id; care.contactProvider -> provider.id; care.openSecureDoc -> document.id. Stable entity ids: appt-*, prov-*, plan-*, pkg-*, spec-*, task-*, doc-*.

core-oidc-auth (auth.oidc).note: data-state on the auth card. checking-session = initial bootstrap on every page load (incl. the return from /core/oauth2-callback.html): discovery + session restore from browser storage; non-interactive, claims no redirect, reveals no name — Codex resolves it to ready-signed-out / ready-signed-in / unavailable. Demo cycle: auth.oidcSignIn → redirecting (1.6s) → ready-signed-in (sets the fixture display name); auth.signOut → signing-out (1.4s) → ready-signed-out. In production 'redirecting' persists until the browser unloads for Core and 'unavailable' is set by Codex when discovery or the authorization library fails to initialize. Preview any state via the dev-toolbar 'oidc' select (visible on the route).

seo-cta (seo.landing).note: Fixed action ids: seo.cta.book / seo.cta.quote (primary, destination from cms.meta.primaryCta.destination), seo.cta.call, seo.cta.services (jump to grid), seo.service.select (grid card → booking/quote flow). Demo lifecycle: pending 900ms → success 800ms → booking drawer. 'error' is set by Codex on real command failure; preview any state via dev-toolbar 'cta' select (state.seoCtaForce). Wave 11: honest-navigation CTAs (nav.* / auth.gotoSignin) have NO lifecycle — data-state stays idle and ignores seoCtaForce.

seo-products-teaser (seo.landing).note: Follows the global dev-toolbar view switch (state select). ready = 3–4 seo-product-teaser-card from pim.products[] (data-product-code); empty = seo-products-teaser-empty (honest copy, section CTA hidden); loading = skeleton cards. Every interactive element fires nav.products only.

retreat-card (care, Pest Control).note: Visual states only — demo body of care.requestRetreat sets 'requesting' and stops; 'used' shows the guarantee-spent copy with a disabled button. Codex owns the real request, resolution and entitlement check. Preview via dev-toolbar 'retreat' select (visible on the pest care hub) or state.careRetreat.

follow-up-tasks (care, Health).note: care.completeTask toggles the per-task visual state (state.careTasksDone overrides the fixture done flag). Codex owns real task completion and sync.

specialist-picker (care, Beauty).note: care.selectSpecialist data-id = specialist.id (stable, e.g. spec-beauty-01); state.careSpecialist overrides the fixture preferredId. Codex owns persisting the preference.

notImplementedYet.note: All required routes are implemented. Remaining gaps are component-level states (e.g. per-field disabled) that Codex wires with real validation.
